how: Your outline and style pictures go to Google's Nano Banana Pro (partner); Recraft then removes the background.
goodFor: a game sprite in my art style
limits: partner credits, priced at the run
use: Drop a picture on its well
Write what you want in the words field
Press Run on Comfy Cloud and confirm the price (about 3 cr)

name: Equirectangular HDR Skybox Generator
what: Makes a 360 HDR skybox (equirectangular) from words, for games and 3D lighting.
how: Qwen-Image runs on Comfy Cloud with a 360 LoRA to draw the panorama, then SeedVR2 upscales it.
use: Write what you want in the words field
Open More settings for the seed, size or steps if you need them
Press Run on Comfy Cloud and confirm the price (GPU time)

name: Single Image to Animated Sprite Sheet
what: Upload a single image to generate an animated sequence.
how: This workflow sends a picture and your words to Google (Nano Banana 2) through Comfy's partner nodes; their model does the work on their side and Comfy Cloud brings back a picture (PNG) and a clip (MP4). It is billed in partner credits, at the price Cloud estimates before the run.
limits: partner credits, priced at the run
use: Drop a picture on its well
Write what you want in the words field
Press Run on Comfy Cloud and confirm the price
